---
title: "Building and testing"
---

These commands run from the repository root. Python dependencies are managed with `uv`; Node is needed to develop or rebuild the frontend.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/datasophos/ToFScope.git
cd ToFScope
uv sync --frozen
```


[How ToFScope works](30-architecture.qmd) provides an overview of the application and its build.

The following commands run the frontend checks and build, followed by the Python and distribution checks:

```sh
npm --prefix frontend ci
npm --prefix frontend run generate:api
npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
npm --prefix frontend test
npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e
uv run python scripts/build_frontend.py
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
uv build
uv run python scripts/check_distribution.py --artifacts dist --output /tmp/tofscope-distribution
uv run python scripts/check_container.py
```

Prebuilt assets are included in both the wheel and source distribution. A source build fails if assets are missing or stale. CI checks generated API drift, scientific and service tests, frontend behavior, the installed package offline, and the container.


[Maintaining the documentation](42-documentation.qmd) covers building and previewing this site.
